evals.prompt: Write a PRD for a team notification feature
evals.expected_output: A PRD with problem statement, goals and non-goals, target users, user stories with acceptance criteria, success metrics, and open questions. No implementation details.

evals.prompt: Draft user stories with acceptance criteria for file upload
evals.expected_output: Stories in the standard role-feature-benefit form, each with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria covering success, size and type limits, and failure cases.

evals.prompt: Generate release notes from these commit messages
evals.expected_output: Notes grouped by change type (features, fixes, breaking changes) written for end users rather than developers, with migration steps for breaking changes.
